clave: Chasing blows up bankrolls; hedging pays double vig. Walk away and reset.
resumen: Chasing (inflating stakes after losing) and hedging (betting the other side out of fear) destroy edge: chasing blows up bankrolls; hedging pays double vig and turns +EV positions into guaranteed losses. The recipe: walk away, reset, and re-enter only on the system's terms.
